messages.Sarcinile sunt considerate punctiforme,: The charges are treated as point charges in vacuum. Arrows F₁ and F₂ show the forces on q₁ and q₂. The drawing and arrow lengths are schematic.
messages.Legea lui Coulomb descrie interacțiunea: Coulomb’s law describes the electric interaction between two stationary point charges. The force magnitude is directly proportional to the product of the charge magnitudes and inversely proportional to the square of their separation.
messages.constanta lui Coulomb în vid: aproximati: Coulomb’s constant in vacuum: approximately 8.99 × 10⁹ N·m²/C²
messages.Forțele acționează de-a lungul dreptei c: The forces act along the line joining the charges. Like charges repel, while opposite charges attract. The forces exerted on each other have equal magnitudes and opposite directions, in accordance with Newton’s third law.
